blocks.en: Here, the coefficients $A_{kl}^{IJ}$ and $c^{IJ}$, $I,J=1,\ldots,N$, $k,l=1,\ldots,n$, are assumed to be sufficiently smooth, and the summation convention is assumed to hold from $1$ to $N$ for repeated uppercase indices and from $1$ to $n$ for repeated lowercase indices.
blocks.zh: 这里假设系数 $A_{kl}^{IJ}$ 和 $c^{IJ}$, $I,J=1,\ldots,N$, $k,l=1,\ldots,n$, 足够光滑, 并约定: 重复的大写指标从 $1$ 到 $N$ 求和, 重复的小写指标从 $1$ 到 $n$ 求和.
